page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.6xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 24 dedicated physical cores and 24 vCPUs, paired with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding an 8.0 GB memory-to-core ratio. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the ecs.r7.6xlarge in the average performance tier for most standard compute and memory operations. It achieves a Geekbench multi-core score of 11384.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 29229.28. In memory-intensive tasks, it registers a read-only large block memory bandwidth of 129.12 GB/sec and a write bandwidth of 62.93 GB/sec. Notably, the instance demonstrates strong performance in small-scale language model text generation, processing 283.7 tokens per second with a 135M parameter model, while maintaining average speeds of 14.18 tokens per second on a 7B model.

Given its dedicated Intel Xeon architecture and high memory density without the added cost of bundled local NVMe storage or GPUs, this instance offers a balanced cost-to-resource profile for memory-bound workloads. The 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it highly suitable for enterprise databases, in-memory caching layers such as Redis, large-scale data processing, and mid-sized web serving applications that require substantial memory capacity without requiring ultra-low latency local disk I/O.
